_comment: OFFICIAL rules (2026-11-21 day kit, data/brand/tools.json: 8 functions). Every rule the CODE checks lives here; prompt.md keeps prose only. functions/_default = pre-execution gate (team/agent/gate.py) and the generated [함수 실행 규칙] prompt section. kind read = lookup (no consent), write = registers something. confirm 'context' = the official call logs register a request in the same turn the customer gives the value or the choice: the gate checks values are present and grounded in the conversation (not only in a lookup made this turn), no refusal / hesitation, and the request ('intent' regex) in the conversation. value_args = arguments that must be grounded ('a.b' walks into lists); require_any = at least one of them. formats = regex on the value with separators removed, write functions only (official order numbers are YYYYMMDD-NNNNNNN = 8+7 digits, item codes add 2 digits): a lookup with an odd number just returns not_found, a registration with one is never sent. handoff = hand-off signal keywords (memo only), handoff_note = the memo's instruction. consent = refusal / hesitation words. output_check = word patterns of the output check's unconfirmed-time rule. Regex values are Python re syntax.
handoff_note: 시나리오에 따라 상담원에게 넘길 상황인지 판단하고, 넘길 때는 상담원이 이어서 도와드린다고 안내할 것. 건강 관련 판단은 단정하지 말 것.

output_check._comment: Output check 'time' (team/agent/output_guard.py): a non-question, non-negated sentence with a time word AND a contact/booking word is replaced unless a function result carries a time value, or every time word is stated by the brand material itself (relative days such as 내일 never count as stated). policy = a sentence stating the brand's general contact practice (EX07 '업무 시간인 오전 10시부터 … 순서대로 연락드리고') is not a booked time and passes.
